nrails_snapToRail.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.snapToRail() end
nrails_snapToRail.title: BeamNG.NRails: snap to rail
nrails_snapToRail.desc: Puts your vehicle on the nearest railway track (within 40 m), along it the way it faces: a train's wheels between the rails, any other vehicle just over them (Ctrl+Shift+T).

nrails_reloadArea.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.reloadArea(beamngEarth_core) end
nrails_reloadArea.title: BeamNG.NRails: reload area
nrails_reloadArea.desc: Asks the world server for the whole area round you again: roads, rails, buildings that did not come (Ctrl+Shift+G).

nrails_toggleWindow.title: BeamNG.NRails: show / hide the window
nrails_toggleWindow.desc: The BeamNG.Earth window with Teleport, Snap to rail and Reload area (Ctrl+Shift+U).

nrails_switchLeft.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('left') end
nrails_switchLeft.title: BeamNG.NRails: next turnout to the left
nrails_switchLeft.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its leftmost route (Ctrl+Shift+Left).

nrails_switchStraight.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('straight') end
nrails_switchStraight.title: BeamNG.NRails: next turnout straight
nrails_switchStraight.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its straight route (Ctrl+Shift+Up).

nrails_switchRight.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.setNext('right') end
nrails_switchRight.title: BeamNG.NRails: next turnout to the right
nrails_switchRight.desc: The next turnout ahead of your train takes its rightmost route (Ctrl+Shift+Right).

nrails_toggleHelp.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.toggleHelp() end
nrails_toggleHelp.title: BeamNG.NRails: keys help on / off
nrails_toggleHelp.desc: Shows or hides the list of NRails' keys (Ctrl+Shift+I).

nrails_toggleSchema.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.toggleSchema() end
nrails_toggleSchema.title: BeamNG.NRails: track diagram on / off
nrails_toggleSchema.desc: The diagram of the tracks and turnouts round your train, shown until pressed again: click a branch to set a turnout, a track to set an itinerary (Ctrl+Shift+M).

nrails_couple.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.couple(true) end
nrails_couple.title: BeamNG.NRails: couple the rail vehicles near
nrails_couple.desc: Coupling armed 60 s on your vehicle and the rail vehicles within 80 m: they couple when their couplers come within 2 m (Ctrl+Shift+O).

nrails_uncouple.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.couple(false) end
nrails_uncouple.title: BeamNG.NRails: uncouple

nrails_toggleGuide.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.toggleGuide() end
nrails_toggleGuide.title: BeamNG.NRails: rail guidance on / off
nrails_toggleGuide.desc: The train's wheels held on the track (no sway, no climbing the rail) or free physics as before (Ctrl+Shift+B).

nrails_regToggle.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.regToggle() end
nrails_regToggle.title: BeamNG.NRails: speed regulator on / off
nrails_regToggle.desc: The train's speed regulator (cruise control) set at the speed now, or off (Ctrl+Shift+K).

nrails_regUp.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.regStep(5) end
nrails_regUp.title: BeamNG.NRails: speed regulator +5 km/h

nrails_regDown.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.regStep(-5) end
nrails_regDown.title: BeamNG.NRails: speed regulator -5 km/h

nrails_config.onDown: if beamngEarth_core and beamngEarth_core.nrails then beamngEarth_core.nrails.toggleConfig() end
nrails_config.title: BeamNG.NRails: train configurator
nrails_config.desc: The consist, its length, mass, stopping distances, the length allowed where it runs, and vehicles added behind it (Ctrl+Shift+J).
